rounds.text: Tahmar Enterprises Ltd is deeply undervalued relative to its asset backing, trading at a price-to-book ratio of 0.77x based on a share price of ₹ 4.00 against a book value of ₹ 5.20 [E1]. This valuation discount is even more pronounced when compared to the broader sector benchmark price-to-book ratio of 5.54x, against which the stock sits at just 0.87x [E6]. Beyond this asset discount, the business has demonstrated explosive medium-term top-line expansion, achieving a compounded sales growth rate of 204% over 5 years [E14], which comfortably outpaces the sector median sales growth of 11.5% [E67]. Recent operational momentum also shows green shoots, supported by sequential sales growth quarter-over-quarter and accelerating earnings growth [E57, E58]. Conceded: [E3, E4, E7, E8, E15, E16, E48, E61].
